हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/nL9tQE
show.description: “Kismat Ka Khel” is a family thriller about Angad, a kind-hearted young man raised in poverty, unaware that he is the lost heir of a billionaire family and grandson of a powerful RAW Chief. When his parents reunite with him after 20 years, they hide their true identities to protect him from dangerous enemies. Amid love, betrayal, class conflict, and hidden conspiracies, Angad uncovers his past and joins his family in a battle against ISI agents threatening their lives and the nation. Watch now!
